plan.title: Email notification integration on bid invitation

steps.note: Create an RFQ event to provide a real bid-invitation trigger.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Use an RFQ because publishing it sends the bid invitation to invited vendors.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the event can be completed.
Add the required line item for the RFQ.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before scheduling and publishing.
Commit a valid event schedule required for publishing.
Add a recipient for the bid-invitation notification.
Publish the event to cause the bid-invitation workflow trigger.
Confirm Procol successfully created the published event before checking the external notification.

args.need: verify the configured outbound email integration received the bid invitation, compare its recipient, subject, body, action links, and attachments with Procol, and confirm the integration has no error

steps.note: The external email system and integration records are not observable through catalog steps.
Assert that the Procol screen remains free of visible errors after the trigger.
